comparison_identity_domains_note: Used only by the test harness to state the mapping; not adopted Lattice identities.

findings.finding: A worker definition-name change under the same worker definition and revision changed the bundle identity and revision, but propose classified no change and refused the adaptation as malformed.
findings.resolution: New changes worker_bundle (set whenever the recorded worker bundle identity changes) and worker_name; every revision-changing difference is classified. Test: a_proposal_is_refused_or_unchanged_outside_one_definition (name-only change yields [worker_bundle, worker_name]; a worker revision change yields [worker_revision, worker_bundle]).

findings.finding: Changing only an entry's bytes kept its reported SHA-256 matching the inventory, so compare reported nothing while the materialized identity changed.
findings.resolution: The harness recomputes each regular file's SHA-256 from its supplied bytes, with the hash provider of the ring TLS 1.3 suite TLS13_AES_128_GCM_SHA256 in the existing rustls dev-dependency (checked against the standard vectors and every recorded fixture digest), and compares that with the inventory; a reported digest that disagrees with the bytes is reported_digest_mismatch. Case content_only_change: [changed_file, reported_digest_mismatch]. A first fix used a new sha2 dev-dependency; it was removed because it changed Octet's root configuration and profile hashes and re-keyed every root finding.

findings.finding: The expansion ratio used the observed layer size without checking it against the manifest descriptor's size.
findings.resolution: An observed size that differs from the descriptor's is layer_size_mismatch, and the ratio is then taken over the smaller size. Case layer_size_mismatch (observed 100000, declared 512, expanded 40000): [expansion_ratio_exceeded, layer_size_mismatch].

findings.finding: The bundled case-triage SKILL.md referenced references/policy.md, which the plugin did not carry, and only SKILL.md was compared.
findings.resolution: The plugin bundles the whole case-triage tree (SKILL.md, references/policy.md, scripts/analyze.py); each bundled skill's tree identity (lattice-agent-package-skill-tree-v1) enters the closure and equals the reviewed skill's. Case incomplete_bundled_skill: [missing_file], and the test asserts its tree differs. comparison-report.json regenerated through the_comparison_report_is_recorded; the plugin revision changed accordingly.

findings.finding: The version annotation was described as excluded from every identity, but changing it changes the manifest digest, which feeds the evidence subject and the lifecycle revision.
findings.resolution: The decision document, spec, changelog and report state that it is not a direct input but changes the manifest digest and therefore the evidence subject and revision; the lifecycle test shows an annotation-only change under the same declared digest keeps the revision and the new manifest digest changes it.
